description: The judgments the record holds for a provision, each checked: is the text the court applied still the text in force (today, or on a date), and if not, which laws changed it and how? Also checks any one decision by the day it was decided (decided).

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

decided.description: The day a decision was made, YYYY-MM-DD, to check that decision too.

max_results.description: Recorded judgments to check, latest first (default 50, at most 500).

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision.

name: check_precedent
title: Check precedent
